title: Izmir Public Services Open Data Snapshot
subtitle: Five geospatial public-service layers with provenance, QA and CC BY 4.0
description:
A reproducible geospatial snapshot of five public-service layers from the İzmir Metropolitan Municipality Open Data Portal: duty pharmacies, pharmacies, hospitals, street markets, and emergency assembly areas.

The records are normalized into a common CSV schema and published with provenance, retrieval timestamps, coverage status, validation evidence, and a data dictionary.

### Useful for
- geospatial exploratory data analysis
- public-health and urban-service visualization
- source-aware proximity experiments
- educational notebooks
- open-data engineering and QA examples

### Provenance
Publisher: İzmir Büyükşehir Belediyesi
Portal: https://acikveri.bizizmir.com
License: CC BY 4.0
Attribution: İzmir Büyükşehir Belediyesi Açık Veri Portalı

### Responsible-use boundary
This snapshot does not claim walking, driving, transit, accessibility, or emergency-response travel time. Missing source data does not imply service absence. No user location or other personal user data is included.

Project: https://github.com/senih25/15-dakika-izmir
Live app: https://15-dakika-izmir.vercel.app
